note: Non-plugin package candidates (modules, scripts, completions) for the numan registry. The plugin backlog lives in numan-plugins/docs/backlog.json and cannot express these types. Source: awesome-nu README (Scripts and Custom Completions sections) mined 2026-10-31, cross-referenced against registry/index.json, registry/provisional.json, specs/, and docs/intake-state.json, with each candidate's upstream repo cloned and inspected (entry shape, license file, last commit) before listing. Status values: CANDIDATE (shape verified, ready for intake work), NEEDS_LICENSE (no license file found upstream; author outreach required before any mirror), STALE (dormant upstream; listed for completeness, revive on demand). Awesome-nu's Custom Completions section produced no entries: all five items (cargo, git, make, npm, winget) are already registry packages sourced from nu_scripts. Its Integrations and Editor Extensions sections are external tools, not .nu packages, and are out of scope here.

schema_fields.name: Proposed registry package name
schema_fields.type: Registry package type: module | script | completion
schema_fields.awesome_nu_section: awesome-nu section the candidate was mined from
schema_fields.entry: Entry file or module root a package would ship
schema_fields.license: License identified from the repo's license file, or null when none was found
schema_fields.last_activity: Date of the latest upstream commit at verification, or the listing source when not applicable

candidates.name: nushell-modules
candidates.description: Simple but cool snippet manager for Nushell (plus a remind module).
candidates.note: Module collection shipping snip (snippet manager, the awesome-nu entry point) and remind. 12 .nu files, 56 export defs, mod.nu present. Strongest module candidate in this pass.

candidates.name: vouch
candidates.description: A community trust management system based on explicit vouches to participate.
candidates.entry: mod.nu (plus a CLI with def main)
candidates.note: Community trust management system by Mitchell Hashimoto. 16 .nu files, 128 export defs, has its own test suite. High-profile upstream; expect upstream interest in how it is packaged.

candidates.name: nu-salesforce
candidates.description: Bring the power of Nu's focus on structured data to your Salesforce data.
candidates.note: Typed Salesforce client module: auth, bulk, query, rest, sobject. 53 export defs. Live proof will need Salesforce credentials, same pattern as the BigQuery credential-gated proof.

candidates.name: nu-quickbooks
candidates.description: A Nu wrapper for the QuickBooks API, with native Nu examples for commands.
candidates.note: QuickBooks client module: auth, batch, cdc, entity, query. 24 export defs. Live proof will need QuickBooks credentials (credential-gated, like BigQuery).

candidates.name: nu-cmd-stack
candidates.description: Scroll through the list of Nushell commands using ctrl+alt+j/k shortcuts.
candidates.note: Small focused module from a known registry author (numd, dotnu). Keyboard-driven command stack UI (ctrl+alt+j/k).

candidates.name: sessionizer
candidates.description: A fuzzy finding sessionizer for Tmux.
candidates.note: GitLab-hosted (registry mirrors are GitHub-only so far; intake needs a GitLab source check). Single module file, 6 export defs, tmux sessionizer with tests. Most recently active candidate in this pass.

candidates.name: nu_rust_ast
candidates.description: Harvest symbols from Rust projects into structured Nushell records.
candidates.note: Single-file module, 26 export defs: harvests symbols from Rust projects into structured records.

candidates.name: nu-aws-service-reference
candidates.description: Browse and discover AWS Service Authorization Reference interactively in Nushell.
candidates.note: Single-file module, 1 export def wrapping interactive browsing of the AWS Service Authorization Reference.

candidates.name: alias-finder
candidates.description: Alias finder for Nushell.
candidates.note: Single-file module, 1 export def. Same author as KamilKleina/git-aliases, already in the registry as a module.

candidates.name: nu-telegram-bot
candidates.description: Interacting with Telegram's bot api.
candidates.note: Single-file module, 7 export defs, Telegram Bot API wrapper. Dormant since 2024-06; verify against current Nu before intake. Live proof needs a bot token.

candidates.name: math_functions
candidates.description: Math functions for doing things like factorial, root.
candidates.note: Module file inside nushell/nu_scripts (repo-level MIT). Registry already mirrors nu_scripts completions as packages; this extends the same treatment to its module files. Pin to a nu_scripts commit at intake.

candidates.name: ultimate_extractor
candidates.description: Function to extract archives with different extensions.
candidates.note: Module file inside nushell/nu_scripts. Archive extraction helper covering many formats. Pin to a nu_scripts commit at intake.

candidates.name: get-weather
candidates.description: Get weather forecast for your location.
candidates.note: Module file inside nushell/nu_scripts. Weather by location; overlaps the wttr script's space but is a distinct upstream source and shape (module, not script). Pin to a nu_scripts commit at intake.

candidates.name: panache-git
candidates.description: A Git prompt that summarizes the current status of your Git repository.
candidates.note: Prompt module inside nushell/nu_scripts, styled after posh-git. Prompt modules activate differently from command modules; confirm the module activation path covers prompt use at intake. Pin to a nu_scripts commit at intake.

candidates.name: powerline
candidates.description: Powerline prompt for nushell.
candidates.note: Powerline prompt module, 13 export defs, active. No license file in the repo: outreach to fj0r (already a registry author via ai.nu, git.nu, docker.nu) before mirroring.

candidates.name: nu-http-client-generator
candidates.description: Generates a typed Nushell HTTP client module from an OpenAPI 3.0, Swagger 2.0, or GraphQL schema.
candidates.note: Generates typed Nu HTTP clients from OpenAPI/Swagger/GraphQL specs; proper module with def main as well, 365 .nu files (mostly its own test fixtures). No license file: outreach before mirroring. Same author as conventional-commits, already in the registry.

candidates.name: discord
candidates.description: Nushell wrapper for the Discord REST API.
candidates.note: Single-file Discord REST API wrapper, 14 export defs. No license file: outreach before mirroring.

candidates.name: todo
candidates.description: Yet another TODO, but nu.
candidates.note: Todo module, 44 export defs across 11 files including its own completion file. No license file: outreach before mirroring.

candidates.name: fsattr
candidates.description: Nu commands for filesystem attributes.
candidates.note: awesome-nu entry points at posix/fsattr.nu inside a personal commands collection (wrappers, news, yt siblings). Package just the fsattr entry if the author agrees. No license file: outreach before mirroring.

candidates.name: nu-http-client-collection
candidates.description: A customizable collection of Nushell HTTP clients generated by the nu-http-client-generator.
candidates.note: Generated collection of 2,533 client .nu files (about 356 MB of git history). A single mirror package is impractical; the realistic shape is per-client packages generated from the sibling generator, or skipping the collection and packaging the generator only. No license file either. Listed so the awesome-nu entry is accounted for, not because intake is straightforward.

candidates.name: nu_script_time_sync
candidates.description: Check if your system clock is drifting using the Time.now API.
candidates.note: Repo yields two tools awesome-nu lists separately: time-sync (clock drift check) and world-time (timezone lookup). Export defs with no def main, the same shape as nu_script_gh_status and nu_script_hnews, which sit in the registry as install-only scripts. Author already has three scripts in the registry.

candidates.name: wi
candidates.description: A linguist wrapper for the terminal.
candidates.note: Single-file script with a nu shebang and no .nu extension; packaging must preserve the executable name wi. Wraps the external github-linguist binary, which stays a user-installed prerequisite.

candidates.name: libvirt-hooks-nushell
candidates.description: Feature-packed libvirt hooks scripts for Nushell.
candidates.note: libvirt hook scripts with a real def main entry, one of the few script candidates that can declare script activation immediately. No license file: outreach before mirroring.

candidates.name: nupk
candidates.description: Simplifying package installation, updates, and uninstallation from GitHub Releases.
candidates.note: A package installer for Nu itself, with its own registry/ directory of package definitions. Catalog overlap with numan is a product question for the maintainer, not a blocker to listing. No license file: outreach before mirroring.

candidates.name: npup
candidates.description: Puppet based on nushell.
candidates.note: Puppet-style system configurator written in Nu, 27 export defs across 8 files. No upstream commit since 2023-12 and no license file; revive only if demand appears.

candidates.name: nu-refreshenv-win
candidates.description: Refresh PATH on Windows like in chocolatey.
candidates.note: Windows-only PATH refresh, a single plain def with no export and no main, so it fits neither module nor script activation as-is; it would ship install-only. No license file, dormant since 2024-07. Author has nufetch in the registry.
